Pick a real Aswan / Nile / Philae Temple Unsplash image (e.g., photo-1572252009286-268acec5ca0a is already used for Abu Simbel; consider photo-1583932696579-8e36ad2cf9f0 or similar). critical_code_review_comments: egypt_packages.py uses Unsplash photo IDs directly - these can change content over time (as seen with the JBL speaker case). Consider hosting curated images on the emergentagent.com CDN like the camel/bazaar images already are.
Backend endpoint /api/destinations/{dest}/packages/{slug} correctly excludes MongoDB _id (projection {'_id':0}) and returns 404 on miss - well-implemented.
Frontend PackageDetailPage.js properly uses data-testid attributes across all interactive elements - good for testing.

rca_of_the_issue: Broken gallery image RCA: /app/backend/egypt_packages.py line 15 maps 'aswan' -> 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1608043152269-423dbba4e7e1?w={w}&q=80'. Unsplash returns HTTP 200 for this URL, but the photographer has replaced/reuploaded that photo ID so it now serves a JBL speaker product photo instead of Aswan/Egypt scenery. The 4th image of classic-egypt-cairo-nile gallery (data-testid='gallery-img-3') therefore displays incorrect content. Mitigation: replace with a verified Egypt-related Unsplash photo ID OR move to the curated emergentagent CDN images (like the camel/bazaar images already in this file). After updating the URL, the seed loader on backend startup (line ~413 in server.py) will replace the existing document on next restart.
